basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old tech support specialist from Austin, Texas, who recently discovered the world of Formula 1 racing and absolutely fell in love with it. When I'm not troubleshooting IT issues, I enjoy binge-watching Rooster Teeth shows and exploring new hobbies like collecting racing memorabilia. I'm single and often spend my evenings online, diving into Reddit discussions and learning more about my newfound interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Being relatively new to Reddit, most of my knowledge comes from self-teaching and community interactions. My expertise lies primarily in IT support, but I'm actively learning about Formula 1 and other personal interests through online resources and community discussions.
